title: The App is perfect for my need
body:
I am loving the app so far as I am quite heavily dependent on a habit tracker. I was using Notion to manage it but ever since finding Habitify I have been able to proceed with better results and having a more preicse habits.

There is one issue that I would like to have address, there are some features that the macOS standalone app doesn't have which is something that I would really like. Being able to edit the log history, because I have to go to the web app or my phone app whenever I am on my macOS in case I entered a wrong entry to delete it. 

So please, do bring it.
